question:
A 4-year-old female presents for a routine check-up at her general practitioner's office. She is thriving,
with good appetite, normal social interactions, and appropriate energy levels. Her immunizations are
current, and she attends daycare. She has no history of hospitalizations, surgeries, regular
medications, or known drug allergies. During the examination, she engages appropriately with toys and
the examiner. Her growth parameters consistently track along the 50th percentile. She is afebrile with
normal findings on examination of eyes, ENT, heart, lungs, and skin. However, abdominal examination
reveals a non-tender mass in the left flank. Further evaluation shows blood pressure of 132/86 mmHg
and hematuria on urinalysis. Which of the following statements is most accurate? Answer Choices: (A)
The tumor typically shows blastemal cells arranged in serpentine patterns (B) The histological finding
would show primitive neuroectodermal cells in rosette formation (C) The mass is likely composed of
mature adipose tissue with scattered fibrous septa (D) The mass would show predominantly clear cells
with granular cytoplasm (E) This child needs to be evaluated first with a CT scan (F) Microscopy would
reveal small round blue cells with Homer Wright rosettes (G) The primary finding would be sheets of
undifferentiated mesenchymal cells (H) This tumor is generally not related to other congenital defects
(I) The most likely histological finding of this mass is spindle shaped cells with presence of striated
muscle fibers (J) Histology would demonstrate epithelial cells arranged in tubular structures
 A. The mass would show predominantly clear cells with granular cytoplasm
B. The mass is likely composed of mature adipose tissue with scattered fibrous septa
C. The primary finding would be sheets of undifferentiated mesenchymal cells
D. Microscopy would reveal small round blue cells with Homer Wright rosettes
E. This tumor is generally not related to other congenital defects
F. Histology would demonstrate epithelial cells arranged in tubular structures
G. The histological finding would show primitive neuroectodermal cells in rosette formation
H. The tumor typically shows blastemal cells arranged in serpentine patterns
I. The most likely histological finding of this mass is spindle shaped cells with presence of striated
muscle fibers
J. This child needs to be evaluated first with a CT scan
